title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta9

## Persistent vendor trail ownership

Vendor trail selection previously depended on current task membership and a RAM cache. Losing that selection could switch a zone back to its MQTT/History footprint. This beta persists the current vendor cycle and its render independently of task state.

- ZoneLedger owns per-zone cycle/reset identity. The ledger and VendorTrailStore are saved together using Home Assistant storage and restored before normal polling.
- VendorTrailStore retains geometry and a cached SVG artifact for each current zone/cycle. Empty/error polls, docking, idle state, task membership and map revision changes do not delete that artifact.
- A confirmed cycle reset removes only that zone's previous current-cycle artifact. A map edit without confirmed coverage/cycle reset preserves retained geometry.
- Vendor ownership stays sticky within the cycle, including when SVG regeneration fails. A geometry revision regenerates only the affected zone's SVG.
- MQTT is an unbounded timestamped live extension. New vendor geometry removes its confirmed prefix; unmatched pre-adoption session history cannot return as a full footprint fallback.
- History keeps existing individual session SVG archives. Current-cycle rendering can accumulate multiple sessions using the ledger's boundaries.
- Map API exposes persistent ownership and source revisions so the companion card can retain the last SVG through phased refreshes.

## Compatibility and validation

Pair with **Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta5** to remove the frontend 8 m limit and use explicit tail confirmations and isolated History selection.

Numeric zone/sensor migration remains a comparison against the existing public resolver; ZoneLedger is authoritative for trail cycle identity in this release.

Regressions cover retention, empty/error responses, confirmed zone resets, restart recovery, per-zone SVG regeneration, multiple sessions, long tails, confirmed prefix removal, sticky ownership and concurrent reset/render operations. The reported active-zone-92 and docked/empty-task scenarios are represented with synthetic data. The latest beta8 diagnostic files were unavailable in this workspace; replay of those exact captures and physical mower/UI validation remain field checks.
